concepts.title: The Greatest of All: Factors in Common
concepts.definition: Two numbers often share factors, and their greatest common factor is the largest number that divides both exactly; Sameeksha's house-building question in the chapter asks exactly for such a common measure.
concepts.key_idea: Common ground between numbers is measured by their greatest shared factor: the biggest ruler that measures both.

list all factors of 20 and of 30 and mark the common ones
why is the greatest common factor useful for sharing
find a number that divides both 24 and 36 exactly
which is greater the gcf or any other common factor
solve the house building question using common factors

concepts.title: HCF from Common Prime Factors
concepts.definition: Factor both numbers into primes and multiply only the primes they share, at the lowest power each appears: the product is the HCF, the greatest of all common factors.
concepts.key_idea: Common ground lives in shared primes: multiply the shared ones and nothing bigger can divide both.
question_patterns: find the hcf of 12 and 18 using prime factors
find the hcf of 20 and 30
why does multiplying shared primes give the greatest common factor
find the hcf of 16 and 28
which primes are common to 45 and 60
use the hcf to reduce the fraction 12/18

solution_steps.explain: Write each number as a product of primes.
The product of the common primes is the HCF.

concepts.title: Using the HCF in Problems
concepts.definition: The HCF solves sharing problems: the largest equal piece both lengths can be cut into, the biggest group size that splits two teams exactly, all answered by the greatest common factor.
concepts.key_idea: Whenever a question says biggest equal share, the HCF is the tool waiting to be used.
question_patterns: two ribbons of 24 cm and 36 cm are cut into equal longest pieces find the length
find the biggest number dividing both 48 and 60
why does the hcf give the largest equal share

concepts.title: Primes Help Find Common Ground
concepts.definition: Prime factorisation is the honest way to see common ground: primes cannot be split further, so the shared primes show up plainly, and numbers sharing no prime at all are called co-prime.
concepts.key_idea: Co-prime pairs share no prime: their only common factor is 1, the smallest possible common ground.

what does co prime mean

which pairs in the given list are co prime
why are primes the right tools for finding common factors

worked_examples.question_pattern: The numbers 12 and 18 share the common prime factors 2 and 3. Find their HCF.

solution_template.explain: Both factorisations contain a 2 and a 3.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the HCF of 20 and 30, whose common prime factors are 2 and 5.

solution_template.explain: Both numbers carry one 2 and one 5 in their factor trees.
2 times 5 is the greatest factor the two numbers share.
